matt: Heads-up: running paged-attn + flash fusion on p4de with 2B model and seq=8192 shows a mem spike at step ~1200, OOM risk. Can someone repro and paste config + perf logs? cc @jin @kira

jin: On it. Which repo/bench? runtime or opt-bench?

matt: runtime/bench (tools/bench.py). args: --model 2B --seq 8192 --batch 1 --paged-attn --flash-fusion --prefetch=kv_cache:1

kira: I'll kick one off on p4de-3 now. ETA ~10m. tagging @perf-bot to auto-collect traces

perf-bot: Started benchmark on p4de-3. Run id: run_2026_03_17_001. Will upload flamegraphs to /runs/run_2026_03_17_001/artifacts.

sam: Do we have a lightweight repro with smaller steps? maybe seq=4096 and fewer steps to narrow down.

jin: I tried seq=4096 earlier, didn't blow up. I'll try 8192 with OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 and report.

kira: Log from p4de-3 after ~1250 iters:
```
[1250] iter=1250 token=... peak_mem=19.1G kv_cache_bytes=12.3G -> 18.7G at step boundary
[1251] allocation warning: attempted alloc 1.2G, free 0.6G
Traceback: cuda out of memory? but process stayed alive
```

olga: Looks like a KV cache growth: 'kv_cache_bytes: 12.3G -> 18.7G' around the spike. Could be paged cache mis-eviction.

jin: Reproduced on p4de-1 with same args. Attaching perf-bot link: https://internal/runs/run_2026_03_17_001/artifacts/flame.html

matt: Thanks. Can someone bisect by disabling flash-fusion (--no-flash-fusion) and run small run to check if spike goes away?

kira: Running no-flash now. quick result: no mem spike in 2k iters. So seems fusion-related.

sam: I'll open a draft PR to add an assert on kv cache size and an extra metric export. PR: https://git/repo/pull/432

jin: Also trying a patched kernel from my branch that fixes alignment. If that removes spike we'll merge.

perf-bot: Run completed. Summary: with fusion=on peak_mem=19.2G, fusion=off peak_mem=12.6G. Artifacts: /runs/run_2026_03_17_001.

matt: :thumbsup: Good repro. Assigning follow-ups: jin (kernel patch test), kira (more repro on different hardware), sam (PR for metrics).

olga: FYI I'll add this to the perf regression dashboard so future runs alert. will tag group.

matt: Thanks all. If anyone needs the command I used: 
```
python tools/bench.py --model 2B --seq 8192 --batch 1 --paged-attn --flash-fusion --prefetch=kv_cache:1 --steps 2500 --log-interval 50
```

matt: Leaving this thread open for updates.
